post.description:
Submits a nonce trying to validate a block. This is _the_ endpoint for (solo) miners.

Send the parameters in the request body (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), so the passphrase stays out of URLs and access logs. Query string parameters still work for older miners; if a parameter is in both, the body wins.

parameters.name: blockheight
parameters.description: The block height for the submitted nonce. Deprecated in the query string: send it in the request body.

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: The nonce Deprecated in the query string: send it in the request body.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Instead of sending the passphrase you can send the accountId. The account id must be allowed in the configuration of the node. Deprecated in the query string: send it in the request body.

requestBody.description: The submission. Preferred over query string parameters.

secretPhrase.description: The passphrase of the mining account (solo mining). Either this or `accountId`.

accountId.description: Instead of sending the passphrase you can send the accountId. The account id must be allowed in the configuration of the node.

blockheight.description: The block height for the submitted nonce.

result.description: "success" in case of successful submission, otherwise a detailed message of what went wrong

errorCode.description: The calculated deadline for the submission
